text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — EU text-generation is seeing degraded success rates. Need marketing-approved customer-facing status and timing. Ops wants a short confirm window before any publish.
Sam: Confirmed elevated 5xxs on hosted API in eu-west. We're kicking a rollback now. Requesting ~12m to validate first signals.
Priya: Webinar prereg list goes live at 2pm PT. If we wait too long attendees will get surprised. Recommend staged comms: soft alert immediately, fuller update after rollback verification.
Diego: Support queue is spiking. Can we prepare a canned Intercom reply? :loudspeaker:
Maya: Draft short status (for preliminary publish): "Investigating increased errors for text-generation in EU. Engineers are rolling back a recent deploy; updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts?
Sam: Add "no action required from customers" and include status link when we publish: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2023-1432
Priya: Also propose a 2pm PT customer Q&A for impacted customers. We can route registrants to AEs and triage inbound leads.
Diego: Canned reply (support macro): "We're aware of increased errors affecting text-generation in EU. We're rolling back a recent deploy. Follow live updates at <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2023-1432>. Reply 'URGENT' if production is impaired and we'll prioritize."
Maya: Ops prefers we wait until rollback starts to publish ETA-like copy. Marketing wants to soft-publish to avoid surprising customers. Compromise: publish a preliminary "investigating" status now, then swap to a full update after rollback shows stable signals.
Priya: For inbound routing — auto-assign webinar signups from accounts >$5k MRR to AEs. Use Zapier: form -> AE queue. Add utm=inc2023 to links.
Sam: Ops okay with soft publish now but no ETA lines until rollback stabilizes. Keep "updates every 15 minutes".
Maya: Final short status (v1) for publish: "Investigating increased errors for text-generation in EU. Engineers are rolling back a recent deploy. We’ll post updates every 15 minutes. No action required; follow https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2023-1432 for live updates. For customers needing immediate help reply 'URGENT' or contact support@redwood.ai."
Diego: I'll push the canned reply to Intercom and enable the macro. Priya: I'll publish the webinar registration page and pre-reg email with the soft note (region-filtered).
incident-bot: Deploy rollback started on host-gpu-12 at 2023-11-02T14:12:34Z — monitoring.
Sam: Rollback in progress. Publishing v1 (prelim badge) now.
Maya: Published. Short social/web copy for comms: "Prelim: We're investigating an incident affecting text-generation in EU. Follow status for updates. Webinar Q&A at 2pm PT for impacted customers — register: https://redwood.ai/webinars/incident-qa?utm=inc2023"
Priya: Webinar link created; Zapier routing set to AE queue. Pre-reg email scoped to customers in affected regions.
Diego: Support volume peaked then reduced after rollback. Keeping canned reply active; triaging 'URGENT' messages.
Maya: Checkpoint: meet in 30m to decide webinar go/no-go and final status wording. Meeting ~14:42Z. @Sam @Priya @Diego please join.
Sam: Ack.
Priya: Ack.
Diego: Ack.
Maya: Thanks team — good compromise on soft publish + webinar routing. Will post final copy after checkpoint. :rocket:
